newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 24,000 tonnes of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 24,000 tonnes of Chinese corn.

text.p: Five South Korean companies have bought 24,000 tonnes of Chinese corn through a private negotiation, traders said on Monday.
The five companies, which bought the corn last Friday, include Miwon Co Ltd, Korea Purina Inc, Cheiljedang Corp, Taihan Sugar Corp and Woo Sung Feed Mill Co Ltd.

Traders said LG International Corp, importer of the Chinese corn, sold 12,000 tonnes at $145 a tonne, C&F, for arrival on March 10 and sold the remaining 12,000 tonnes at $142 a tonne, C&F, for arrival on April 5.
Arrival was set for the south western port city of Kunsan.
